1.body:
Hi,

I saw your opening for a UI/UX Designer Intern at OpsAI, and I am drawn to how your product team translates complex enterprise requirements into intuitive experiences.

My background combines a computer science degree with hands-on UI/UX work, including conducting usability testing and refining interface flows at AT Creation. I also built reusable visual systems during my time as a graphic designer at Ascent Business Solutions.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates how I design cleaner verification workflows for teams that depend on accurate data, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Could we set up a brief call this week to discuss how I might support your design team?

Ananya
